overall_goal: Perform preparatory tasks including washing hands, retrieving ingredients, weighing items, and logging measurements

goals.rationale: The person turns on the tap, uses hand wash, rubs hands together, rinses them, and dries them with a kitchen towel.

goals.description: Retrieve chicken and condiment jar from storage
goals.rationale: The person opens the refrigerator to get a box of chicken and opens a cabinet to get a condiment jar.
The person moves the chicken, pushes the electric hob away, and repositions condiment jars to make room on the counter.

goals.description: Search for and select mixing bowls
goals.rationale: The person opens the upper shelf, pulls out various bowls, inspects them, puts the unwanted ones back, and closes the shelf.

goals.description: Set up the weighing scale for the chicken
goals.rationale: The person places the weighing scale on the worktop, puts a bowl on it, turns it on, and picks up the raw chicken container to weigh it.
The person closes the empty plastic box, opens the rubbish bin, throws the packaging away, and closes the bin.

goals.description: Wash and dry hands after handling raw chicken
goals.rationale: The person washes their hands under the tap and dries them with a kitchen rag to maintain hygiene after touching raw meat.

goals.description: Season the chicken and manage spice jars
goals.rationale: The person shakes seasoning from spoons into the chicken bowl, shakes the bowl to mix, and handles various condiment jars like garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper.

goals.description: Set up scale and weigh lemon pieces
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a small plate from the upper shelf, places it on the weighing scale, turns the scale on, and places cut lemon pieces on it to measure their weight.

goals.description: Log the ingredient measurements in a notebook
goals.rationale: The person grabs a notebook, finds an empty page, searches for a pen, and writes down the measurements of the weighed ingredients.
